dashboard.name: Myxo Petri Wars play
dashboard.description: Solo play telemetry from Myxo Petri Wars (events with game = myxo-petri-wars): genome edits between matches, and matches needed to clear each plate. Defaults to production and the last 90 days; date and event-property dashboard filters apply to every tile. Player IDs are anonymous per browser.

insights.name: Daily players, sessions and matches
insights.description: Distinct anonymous players and page-load sessions with any play event, and solo matches started, per day.

source.query:
SELECT toDate(timestamp) AS day,
 count(DISTINCT distinct_id) AS players,
 count(DISTINCT properties.$session_id) AS sessions,
 countIf(event = 'match_started') AS matches
FROM events
WHERE properties.game = 'myxo-petri-wars' AND {filters}
GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

insights.name: Matches to clear each plate
insights.description: Median and 75th-percentile matches a player started on a plate up to and including the first win there. Runs whose telemetry began mid-game (run_partial) are left out, as their counts started late.

source.query:
SELECT properties.plate_code AS plate,
 count() AS players_cleared,
 median(toFloat(properties.matches_to_clear)) AS median_matches,
 quantile(0.75)(toFloat(properties.matches_to_clear)) AS p75_matches
FROM events
WHERE event = 'plate_cleared' AND properties.game = 'myxo-petri-wars' AND toString(properties.run_partial) NOT IN ('true', '1') AND {filters}
GROUP BY plate ORDER BY plate

insights.name: Plate clearing detail
insights.description: Per plate, for first clears in complete runs: matches started (mean, median, max), matches walked out of, genome edits and strain loads on the plate before the win.

source.query:
SELECT properties.plate_code AS plate,
 count() AS players_cleared,
 round(avg(toFloat(properties.matches_to_clear)), 2) AS avg_matches,
 median(toFloat(properties.matches_to_clear)) AS median_matches,
 max(toFloat(properties.matches_to_clear)) AS max_matches,
 round(avg(toFloat(properties.matches_abandoned)), 2) AS avg_abandoned,
 round(avg(toFloat(properties.edits_on_plate)), 1) AS avg_edits,
 median(toFloat(properties.edits_on_plate)) AS median_edits,
 round(avg(toFloat(properties.strain_loads_on_plate)), 2) AS avg_strain_loads
FROM events
WHERE event = 'plate_cleared' AND properties.game = 'myxo-petri-wars' AND toString(properties.run_partial) NOT IN ('true', '1') AND {filters}
GROUP BY plate ORDER BY plate

insights.name: Edits between matches
insights.description: Mean genome edits (clicks) made before each match, and the mean net change from the previous match's genome (levels changed plus genes added or removed). The first match a player ever plays has no previous genome and is left out of the net change.

source.query:
SELECT properties.plate_code AS plate,
 count() AS matches,
 round(avg(toFloat(properties.edits_since_last_match)), 2) AS avg_edits,
 round(avg(toFloat(properties.genome_changes_since_last_match)), 2) AS avg_net_changes,
 round(countIf(toFloat(properties.genome_changes_since_last_match) = 0) / count(), 3) AS share_unchanged
FROM events
WHERE event = 'match_started' AND properties.game = 'myxo-petri-wars' AND {filters}
GROUP BY plate ORDER BY plate

insights.name: Edits and wins by attempt
insights.description: For each plate and attempt number (the nth match a player started there): how many such matches began, the edits before them, the net genome change, and how many of those that reached a summary were won.

source.query:
SELECT properties.plate_code AS plate,
 toInt(properties.plate_match_number) AS attempt,
 countIf(event = 'match_started') AS started,
 round(avgIf(toFloat(properties.edits_since_last_match), event = 'match_started'), 2) AS avg_edits,
 round(avgIf(toFloat(properties.genome_changes_since_last_match), event = 'match_started'), 2) AS avg_net_changes,
 countIf(event = 'match_finished') AS finished,
 countIf(event = 'match_finished' AND properties.outcome = 'win') AS won
FROM events
WHERE event IN ('match_started', 'match_finished') AND properties.game = 'myxo-petri-wars' AND {filters}
GROUP BY plate, attempt ORDER BY plate, attempt LIMIT 300

insights.name: Plate progression
insights.description: Players who started a match on each plate, how many of them cleared it, and how matches there ended: summary reached, won, or walked out of.

source.query:
SELECT properties.plate_code AS plate,
 uniqIf(distinct_id, event = 'match_started') AS players_tried,
 uniqIf(distinct_id, event = 'plate_cleared') AS players_cleared,
 round(uniqIf(distinct_id, event = 'plate_cleared') / greatest(uniqIf(distinct_id, event = 'match_started'), 1), 3) AS clear_rate,
 countIf(event = 'match_started') AS matches,
 countIf(event = 'match_finished' AND properties.outcome = 'win') AS wins,
 countIf(event = 'match_finished' AND properties.outcome = 'loss') AS losses,
 countIf(event = 'match_abandoned') AS abandoned,
 round(avgIf(toFloat(properties.seconds), event = 'match_finished')) AS avg_seconds_to_summary
FROM events
WHERE event IN ('match_started', 'match_finished', 'match_abandoned', 'plate_cleared') AND properties.game = 'myxo-petri-wars' AND {filters}
GROUP BY plate ORDER BY plate

insights.name: Most edited traits and genes
insights.description: What players change in the lab on each plate: traits and drives by name, genes as gene:<id>. Players counts each player once per change.

source.query:
SELECT properties.plate_code AS plate,
 if(properties.field = 'gene', concat('gene:', properties.gene), properties.field) AS changed,
 count(DISTINCT distinct_id) AS players,
 count() AS edits,
 countIf(properties.gene_change = 'added') AS gene_added,
 countIf(properties.gene_change = 'removed') AS gene_removed
FROM events
WHERE event = 'genome_edited' AND properties.game = 'myxo-petri-wars' AND {filters}
GROUP BY plate, changed ORDER BY plate, players DESC, edits DESC LIMIT 300

insights.name: Genomes that cleared each plate
insights.description: The strains that first beat each plate, grouped by identical genome: levels, sorted gene ids and cost against the plate's budget.

source.query:
SELECT properties.plate_code AS plate,
 properties.genome AS genome,
 any(properties.cost_kb) AS cost_kb,
 any(properties.budget_kb) AS budget_kb,
 count() AS players
FROM events
WHERE event = 'plate_cleared' AND properties.game = 'myxo-petri-wars' AND {filters}
GROUP BY plate, genome ORDER BY plate, players DESC LIMIT 200

insights.name: Recent play
insights.description: The latest play events, newest first, for following individual players. Player IDs are anonymous per browser.

source.query:
SELECT timestamp, distinct_id AS player, event,
 properties.plate_code AS plate,
 properties.plate_match_number AS attempt,
 properties.field AS field, properties.from AS from_level, properties.to AS to_level,
 properties.gene AS gene, properties.gene_change AS gene_change,
 properties.edits_since_last_match AS edits_since_match,
 properties.outcome AS outcome, properties.why AS why,
 properties.matches_to_clear AS matches_to_clear
FROM events
WHERE properties.game = 'myxo-petri-wars' AND {filters}
ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 200
